title: VP of Product Management

role_match.role_rationale_from_stage3: This role owns Roland DGA's product portfolio strategy, media recommendations, and customer success outcomes. Given Roland's TrueVIS printers are certified for 3-4 years outdoor durability, Tedlar represents a strategic opportunity to extend their value proposition to 12-20+ years—a 3-5x improvement that would dramatically differentiate Roland's solutions in the competitive wide-format printer market. This executive would care deeply about: (1) Enhancing Roland's 3M MCS and Avery Dennison ICS warranty certifications by pairing printers with premium overlaminates, (2) Reducing customer complaints about premature fading, cracking, or UV damage on vehicle wraps and outdoor signage, which directly impacts Roland's brand reputation and customer retention, (3) Creating bundled solutions (printer + ink + Tedlar overlaminate) that command premium pricing and improve gross margins, and (4) Competitive differentiation against Mimaki, HP Latex, and Epson in the outdoor graphics segment. Their KPIs around customer lifetime value, product differentiation, and market share growth make them the primary strategic decision-maker for materials partnerships.

engagement_strategy.scope_and_authority: [Name] owns Roland DGA's entire product portfolio strategy, media certification programs, and recommended materials ecosystem. They are responsible for product positioning, go-to-market strategy for new printer series (TrueVIS VG3/SG3, VersaOBJECT, EU-1000MF UV flatbed), and maintaining certification partnerships with 3M MCS and Avery Dennison ICS. This role likely reports to the President/GM of Roland DGA and collaborates closely with Sales, Marketing, Technical Support, and the parent company Roland DG in Japan. They influence which media and overlaminate partners Roland recommends to customers, which materials are featured in product bundles, and how Roland positions its solutions against Mimaki, HP Latex, and Epson in outdoor durability applications. This is a strategic decision-maker role with authority to evaluate, pilot, and approve materials partnerships that enhance Roland's competitive positioning.
engagement_strategy.relevant_use_cases: Roland's TrueVIS printers with TR2 eco-solvent inks are currently certified for 3-4 years outdoor durability. Tedlar's 12-20+ year outdoor lifespan as an overlaminate would transform Roland's value proposition in three critical use cases: (1) Vehicle wraps and fleet graphics—where Roland demonstrated a Tesla Cybertruck wrap at PRINTING United 2024 and NASCAR wrap at ISA 2024, Tedlar's graffiti resistance and UV protection would allow fleet operators to maintain pristine graphics for 15+ years instead of 3-4 years, dramatically reducing total cost of ownership; (2) Durable outdoor signage—where Roland competes with Mimaki and HP for permanent installations, Tedlar eliminates fading, cracking, and yellowing that plague standard laminates, giving Roland a documented performance advantage; (3) Architectural graphics and building wraps—where Roland's UV flatbeds serve facade applications, Tedlar's weather resistance (-70°F to 230°F) and mold/mildew resistance ensure graphics survive harsh climates without degradation. For [Name]'s team, Tedlar enables Roland to move upmarket from commodity 3-4 year graphics to premium 12-20 year solutions with measurably superior ROI.
engagement_strategy.personal_stakes: [Name] is personally accountable for product differentiation, customer lifetime value, and Roland's market share in the outdoor graphics segment. Their KPIs likely include: product margin contribution, customer satisfaction/NPS scores for media recommendations, warranty claim rates related to outdoor durability failures, competitive win rates against Mimaki/HP/Epson, and new product launch success metrics. Tedlar directly impacts these metrics by: (1) Reducing warranty claims and customer service escalations caused by premature UV damage, fading, or cracking on outdoor applications—failures that damage Roland's brand reputation and create costly support burdens; (2) Enabling premium pricing for Roland printer + Tedlar overlaminate bundles that improve gross margins while delivering superior customer ROI; (3) Creating a defensible competitive advantage—while competitors offer similar 3-4 year durability claims, Roland + Tedlar delivers documented 12-20+ year performance that's difficult to replicate; (4) Increasing customer retention and referrals by delivering measurably better long-term results that generate testimonials and reduce churn. The personal upside for [Name] is owning a product strategy that transforms Roland from a printer vendor to a total solution provider with industry-leading outdoor durability.
engagement_strategy.timing_factors: Roland DGA is actively exhibiting at PRINTING United Expo 2025 (Orlando) and Impressions Expo 2026, with confirmed booth presence and likely live demonstrations similar to their Tesla Cybertruck wrap at PRINTING United 2024. These trade shows are critical moments where [Name]'s product strategy is on full display to sign manufacturers, vehicle wrap installers, and large-format print shops. Additionally, Roland recently launched the TrueVIS VG3/SG3 series (2022) and TY-300 DTF printer (2026), indicating an active product development cycle where media partnerships could be integrated into go-to-market planning. The company's emphasis on 3M MCS and Avery Dennison ICS certifications suggests they are actively managing warranty programs and durability claims—making this an opportune time to introduce Tedlar as a solution that extends warranty coverage and reduces claims. The competitive pressure from Mimaki, HP Latex, and Epson in outdoor graphics also creates urgency for differentiation strategies.

personalization_hooks.hook: Roland's TrueVIS printers are certified for 3-4 years outdoor durability with TR2 inks, but customers in vehicle wraps and architectural graphics are demanding 10-15+ year solutions to reduce replacement cycles
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Open by acknowledging Roland's current 3M MCS and Avery Dennison ICS certifications, then position Tedlar as the strategic partner that extends Roland's value proposition from 3-4 years to 12-20+ years—a 3-5x improvement that repositions Roland as the premium choice for long-term outdoor applications without requiring changes to their printer or ink technology

personalization_hooks.hook: Roland demonstrated a Tesla Cybertruck wrap at PRINTING United 2024 and NASCAR wrap at ISA 2024, showcasing vehicle graphics as a strategic growth area where durability and graffiti resistance are critical customer pain points
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Reference their high-profile vehicle wrap demonstrations and position Tedlar as the overlaminate that ensures those showcase graphics maintain pristine appearance for 15+ years—turning their trade show demos into long-term customer success stories that drive referrals and competitive differentiation

personalization_hooks.hook: As VP of Product Management, [Name] is responsible for competitive positioning against Mimaki, HP Latex, and Epson in a crowded wide-format printer market where outdoor durability claims are increasingly commoditized at 3-4 years
personalization_hooks.messaging_angle: Frame Tedlar as a strategic product portfolio decision rather than a materials choice—a partnership that gives Roland a documented, defensible advantage (12-20 year outdoor lifespan, graffiti resistance, no yellowing/fading) that competitors cannot easily replicate, while improving gross margins through bundled premium solutions

recommended_approach: Lead with the strategic product differentiation angle—acknowledge Roland's current 3-4 year outdoor durability positioning and immediately present Tedlar as the path to 12-20+ year solutions that transform Roland's competitive positioning. Emphasize that this is a portfolio strategy discussion (not a materials sales pitch) focused on how Tedlar enables Roland to move upmarket, reduce warranty claims, and create bundled solutions that command premium pricing. Reference their trade show presence and vehicle wrap demonstrations as proof points that outdoor durability is already a strategic priority, then offer a brief discussion about how other wide-format printer companies have integrated Tedlar into their recommended media stacks. Keep the tone consultative and focused on [Name]'s KPIs: product differentiation, customer lifetime value, and competitive win rates.
